T4.4.message: smarārim (epithet) is explained as 'enemy of Smara (Kāma)' through c7, which is correct (mw-smarari: = smara-śatru). But the line puts smarāmi 'I remember' right next to smarārim, and both come from √smṛ. mw-smara also lists smara as 'memory, remembrance' besides Kāma-deva. The verse looks like it is playing on the name (I remember the enemy of Smara, the 'remembered one'), and no note points this out. None of the evidence translations comments on the wordplay, so I am flagging this rather than failing it.
T4.4.suggested_fix: Add a short note to words.w14.notes: 'smara (Kāma) comes from the same root as smarāmi, "I remember"; the poet remembers the one who burnt Smara, a play on the sound and sense of the two words.' Give the Hindi to match.
